Name: FailureSensorIQ
Summary: Multiple-choice benchmark of 8,296 questions from IBM that tests how well language models relate sensors to failure modes of 10 industrial assets.
Description:
FailureSensorIQ is a dataset and benchmark from IBM Research that probes how large language models reason about sensor and failure-mode relationships in industrial systems. It was presented in the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track (arXiv 2506.03278). The questions were produced by a generation pipeline that uses only information from ISO documents.

The 8,296 questions cover 10 industrial assets: 2,667 have a single correct answer and 5,629 have several. They are published as two JSON Lines subsets, single_true_multi_choice_qa and multi_true_multi_choice_qa, The GitHub repository adds perturbed variants (SimplePert, ComplexPert and OptionsPert) for robustness tests.

The data is hosted on Hugging Face under ibm-research/FailureSensorIQ and loads with the Hugging Face datasets library. The project code is on GitHub under IBM/FailureSensorIQ.
